snippet.description:

✅ 1.5배 커진 글씨, 18포인트로 한눈에 보이는 직관적 인터페이스
✅ 자주 쓰는 메뉴, 바로 터치! 원터치 다이렉트 버튼

✅ 2.1 초고압과 1.0 무압의 두 가지 압력 자동 조절 시스템
✅ 세척이 편리하고 튼튼한 다이킹 코팅 내솥
✅ 또박또박 잘 들리는 음성 도우미 & 큰 글씨 고객센터 스티커

en-US.description:
The final part of our whole family trip to Jeju Island with our dog and 9-month-old baby!

The end of our 15-day stay... ended with us all completely worn out.

The Jeju series is over!

🐶 Geonu's Dog-Friendly Jeju Itinerary (Focusing on Seogwipo)

- Jungmun Saekdal Beach

- Eongdeongmul Valley (Great during canola flower season!)

- Cafe Ocean (Great sunsets)

(Since these three places are close together, I recommend staying overnight!)

Please stop by 'Haenyeo's House'—which we couldn't visit—to enjoy some seafood and a beer!

🐶 Dog-Friendly Cafes

- Turtle Rock

- Cafe Ocean

🐶 Try visiting with your family! - Seogwipo Maeil Olle Market

- Cheonjeyeon Waterfall (No dogs allowed + Be careful, the stairs are hell)
